The event will have its own registration form, payment link, contact lists, and email automation. Our WordPress event webpage and Klaviyo registration form already exist. We require a reusable setup that allows us to create future events without additional programming or paid third-party subscriptions. The freelancer will be responsible for configuration, basic testing, and providing written instructions, with a detailed scope of work available for review.

opportunities.title: Diseño de Identidad de Marca Premium “Klean”
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando un diseñador o estudio creativo para desarrollar la identidad de marca completa de KLEAN, un Sneaker Care & Restoration Studio especializado en limpieza, cuidado, restauración y customización de sneakers y hats. Nuestro objetivo es crear una marca premium, moderna, urbana, minimalista y sofisticada, con una identidad sólida, auténtica y reconocible, diferenciándonos de las lavanderías tradicionales. Referencias conceptuales incluyen a Jason Markk, The Surgeon y Lab Care, por su posicionamiento, estética y experiencia de marca, buscando inspiración sin copiar para desarrollar una identidad propia. El alcance del proyecto incluye: 1. Brand Identity | Identidad visual: - Diseño de logotipo principal y versiones secundarias. - Creación de isotipo o símbolo distintivo. - Desarrollo de un lenguaje visual original, versátil y reconocible. 2. Brand Guidelines | Manual de marca: - Definición de paleta de colores y tipografías. - Establecimiento de normas de uso del logotipo. - Creación de patrones, texturas y recursos gráficos. - Propuestas de aplicaciones para medios físicos y digitales. 3. Uniform Design | Uniformes: - Propuestas de uniformes con estética streetwear. - Diseños modernos, funcionales y profesionales. - Integración de la identidad KLEAN en la vestimenta del equipo. Buscamos un profesional con experiencia en branding, criterio estético y visión estratégica. Se valorará la experiencia previa en marcas premium, lifestyle o streetwear, así como la creatividad, atención al detalle y capacidad para construir una identidad escalable. Los entregables esperados son un sistema de identidad visual completo, manual de marca, propuestas de uniformes, mockups y archivos finales editables, listos para implementación. KLEAN busca elevar el cuidado y la restauración de sneakers a una experiencia de marca que transmita calidad, precisión, exclusividad y cultura en cada detalle, y necesitamos un aliado creativo que transforme esta visión en una marca con personalidad y potencial de crecimiento. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Imagen Corporativa ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Definir desde cero

opportunities.title: Convert AAF for Premiere Audio
opportunities.description: I have an AAF that originated in either Avid Media Composer or Pro Tools, and I need every audio track, clip cut, and automation it contains to come across cleanly into Adobe Premiere Pro. The goal is simple: open a new Premiere project, relink the media, press play, and hear the timeline exactly as it was built in the original system—no missing clips, no drift, no offline items. Please take the AAF, translate it to a Premiere-compatible format, and deliver a project file (or XML) that mirrors all edits and track-layout. If any consolidating, re-linking, or sample-rate conforming is required, handle that as part of the conversion so the finished timeline is ready for immediate mix or further picture edit. Acceptance will be based on: • Premiere project opens without errors. • All audio clips, fades, and edits match the original AAF playback. • No media reported offline. Let me know your turnaround time and any questions about codecs or auxiliary files you might need.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40812208, publicado hace 7 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

opportunities.title: 3D Printing Expert to Optimize Clear PETG Model for Glass-Like Clarity With PETG Filament
opportunities.description: You must be a 3D printing expert. I’m looking for someone experienced in 3D printing clear and translucent PETG to clean up my existing 3D print file and optimize it for my Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 with a 0.8 mm nozzle. I would like my project completed in 5 days. You will adjust the work until it is what I need. My project includes the 3MF file. I need daily updates and screen shots and or screen capture videos so I can add my input if needed. I will require you to sign my work made for hire agreement, and my non reverse engineer agreement. The goal is to make the clear and translucent areas as close to glass-clear as practical and keep the translucent colored areas distinct and light-transmitting. Adjust the height and width size and preserve the existing shape, thickness, and color pattern. I will provide the dimensions. Deliverables - A corrected, print-ready 3MF project with the filament assignments and slicer settings saved. - Short instructions for printing it, including any steps needed to achieve the best clarity. - Photos of previous clear PETG prints you’ve made. Please say whether you can test-print a sample using a 0.8 mm nozzle and show the result in normal light and with backlighting to show how clear it is. In your proposal, briefly describe your experience with clear PETG and what level of clarity you expect to achieve. I will own the full and exclusive copyrights to all 3MF files, text, images, raw files, source files, project files, and all work created for me. I will keep all work you provide the 3MF files, text, images, raw files, source files, project files, and all work created for me. I will release the full milestone when the 3MF files, text, images, raw files, source files, project files, and all work created for me and entire project is completed, checked, delivered, and accepted by me. I do not pay any milestones until 3MF files, text, images, raw files, source files, project files, and all work created for me is completed, all files delivered, all testing, 3MF files, all fixes, all features, all setup, all instructions are completed and accepted by me. If your work is High Quality and exactly what I need I would be interested in considering you for Future projects. I don't communicate on Sundays and I don't expect you to work on Sundays.

Option B — Animation and Editing Only: Using our supplied tiger model, script, voice-over, music, backgrounds, and other production assets. Please include examples of previous 3D character animation, your estimated delivery time, and your fixed price for each option. Long-Term Collaboration: This is the first of an ongoing series of YouTube episodes. We are seeking a talented, reliable animator for long-term collaboration, with consistent opportunities for future projects as our channel grows. Successful completion of this episode will lead to continued work.

opportunities.title: Strategy Game World & Castle Design
opportunities.description: Looking for a Game Developer – Strategy Game World & Castle Environment We are looking for an experienced Game Developer / 3D Environment Artist to create a high-quality strategy game world inspired by Clash of Kings. Project Requirements I need someone who can develop the visual world and castle environment for a real-time strategy game. 1. World Map Development - Large-scale open strategy game world. - Beautiful terrain with grass, mountains, forests, rivers and lakes. - Grid-based or coordinate-based world map. - Multiple locations where players can build their castles. - World map camera controls (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Pan). - Smooth map navigation. - Resource locations and environmental objects. - Optimized environment for multiplayer strategy games. 2. Inner Castle Development - Detailed castle environment. - Main castle building. - Castle walls and defensive towers. - Buildings placement areas. - Roads, gardens and decorative objects. - Different building upgrade visual levels. - Camera controls (Zoom and Rotation). - High-quality and attractive visual design. 3. Technical Requirements - Unity or Unreal Engine (suggest your preferred technology). - Clean and organized project structure. - Optimized 3D models and textures. - Modular environment assets. - Complete editable source project. - All 3D models, textures, materials and animations. - Proper documentation for integration. Important – Project Scope I am developing the remaining game systems myself, including: - Backend and APIs. - Database and player management. - Login and registration. - Troop management. - Battle systems. - Alliance systems. - Resource management. - Building upgrade logic. - Multiplayer functionality. Your responsibility is ONLY to develop the complete visual game world, world map environment and inner castle environment. Reference Game Clash of Kings – I want a similar world-map experience and castle environment, but with our own original game design and assets. What I Expect 1. A working world map. 2. A fully developed inner castle environment. 3. Editable source code/project files. 4. All original assets. 5. Smooth camera controls. 6. Optimized performance. 7. Complete handover of the project. When Applying, Please Share: - Your previous game development portfolio. - Examples of strategy game environments. - Your preferred engine (Unity/Unreal). - Estimated development time. - Total project cost. Note: I am looking for someone who has experience developing strategy game environments, not just someone who can create basic 3D models.

opportunities.title: Python-Node Data Automation Scripts
opportunities.description: This project has three connected pieces and I’d like to tackle them in the order that keeps the workflow smooth for everyone. Phase 1 – Website-to-Excel Scraper We begin by coding a Python scraper that pulls data directly from a set of websites and drops it into clean, well-structured Excel workbooks. The scraper should cope with pagination, basic authentication when needed, and changing HTML layouts (lxml or BeautifulSoup are both fine). I will provide the target URLs and the exact column layout; you make the script resilient and easy to re-point when sites change. As soon as the data lands in Excel, a short Pandas routine should run simple sanity checks so I can trust the numbers. Phase 2 – Automated Word Report Formatting Once the data is in place, a second Python script should transform the analysis output into a polished Word report. Using python-docx and lxml, the script must: • switch every section to landscape orientation, • preserve complex table structures, and • embed any charts or summary text I pass in. The goal is a single-click command that turns raw numbers into a board-ready .docx file without manual tweaking. Phase 3 – Node.js Integration Layer Finally, I need a lightweight Node.js app (Express is fine) where a user can upload new configuration files or even raw data, hit “Run Collection,” and watch the scraper + formatter pipeline execute in the background. Returned status, logs, and finished reports should be delivered as downloadable links and mirrored in a simple JSON API so other services can hook in later. Acceptance check • Scraper writes fully populated Excel files with zero empty header cells. • Formatter outputs a landscape Word report whose style matches the sample template I’ll provide. • Web app uploads a file <20 MB, triggers the Python scripts, and responds with success/fail plus a link to the result within 60 seconds. If you’re comfortable jumping between Python (requests, Pandas, python-docx, lxml) and Node.js (Express, multer, child_process), let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Asistente Virtual WhatsApp para Clientes
opportunities.description: Necesito implementar un asistente virtual que atienda las consultas entrantes por WhatsApp centradas, sobre todo, en preguntas frecuentes acerca de nuestros productos o servicios. La fuente principal de conocimiento serán las propias conversaciones históricas que ya tenemos en la aplicación; el asistente debe analizarlas y reutilizar las respuestas pertinentes para ofrecer información coherente y rápida. Flujo deseado: • Cuando detecte una coincidencia clara en el historial, responde automáticamente. • Si no encuentra una respuesta fiable, deriva la consulta a un miembro del equipo y notifica al cliente que un asesor le contactará pronto. Entregables: • Configuración completa del asistente en nuestro número de WhatsApp (puedes apoyarte en WhatsApp Business API, Twilio, Dialogflow u otra plataforma que conozcas). • Guía breve de uso con el proceso de escalamiento a soporte humano. • Soporte inicial durante las pruebas para pulir respuestas y ajustes básicos. Valoraré experiencia previa creando chatbots para WhatsApp, manejo seguro de datos de clientes y una comunicación clara durante todo el proyecto.

opportunities.title: Desain Rumah Minimalis Keluarga
opportunities.description: Saya sedang merencanakan rumah tinggal sederhana dan minimalis untuk kami—suami-istri dengan tiga anak. Kami ingin bangunan 1 lantai bergaya modern dengan bentuk sederhana dan palet warna netral. Kebutuhan ruang utama • 4 kamar tidur (3 anak + 1 utama) • 2 kamar mandi • Ruang keluarga yang nyaman sebagai pusat aktivitas Apa yang saya harapkan: 1. Konsep denah 2D yang efisien, lengkap dengan zonasi privat–publik, alur sirkulasi, serta area servis terpadu. 2. Gambar tampak fasad yang menonjolkan gaya minimalis modern—garis bersih, bukaan lebar, dan permainan warna netral. 3. opportunities.title: Scalable WhatsApp Management Platform Development
opportunities.description: Development of a Scalable WhatsApp Account Management & Automation Platform Project Overview We are looking for an experienced developer or development team to build a centralized platform for managing multiple WhatsApp accounts and automating business communication workflows. The system should provide a convenient web-based dashboard where administrators can manage connections, monitor account statuses, organize conversations, process incoming messages, and control communication workflows. The platform should be designed with scalability in mind, allowing us to manage 50, 100, 500 or more connections through a centralized infrastructure. Our priority is to develop a reliable and cost-effective solution with a high level of automation and minimal manual intervention. Stage 1. Infrastructure, Registration & Account Management - Deploy the service on a VPS with a dedicated domain. - Configure secure login and password authentication. - Set up the backend infrastructure and database. - Develop a centralized web-based dashboard. - Integrate supported phone number providers and verification services. - Implement automated onboarding and connection setup where supported by the selected WhatsApp integration method. - Evaluate compatibility with virtual phone numbers and different verification providers. - Implement connection status monitoring and error reporting. - Develop convenient account importing, adding, removing and management functionality. - Investigate Android emulator integration and the possibility of running up to 10 instances simultaneously, where technically necessary. - Design the architecture to support 50, 100, 500 or more connections. Stage 1 Deliverable: A working platform deployed on a VPS, with authentication, connection management, onboarding functionality and a centralized dashboard. Stage 2. Automation & Message Management - Implement sequential connection processing. - Develop a task queue for managing multiple accounts. - Implement automated connection health checks. - Develop a centralized inbox for incoming messages. - Automatically retrieve incoming messages and display them in the dashboard. - Identify which account or business connection received each message. - Allow operators to respond to messages directly from the dashboard. - Implement notifications for new incoming messages. - Add message delivery status tracking. - Implement conversation history and contact management. - Develop configurable communication workflows. - Implement campaign management for contacts who have consented to receive communications. Stage 2 Deliverable: A centralized management system with automated message processing, incoming reply monitoring and conversation management. Stage 3. Advanced Automation & Optimization - Implement automated communication workflows. - Develop configurable queues and sending schedules. - Implement configurable message limits according to applicable platform restrictions. - Add connection health monitoring and performance statistics. - Implement automated error handling and recovery mechanisms. - Configure automatic software updates and deployment. - Optimize VPS resources and database performance. - Implement detailed activity logs. - Prepare technical documentation and a user manual. - Include screenshots and step-by-step instructions. - Conduct final testing and provide a demonstration of the completed system. Technical Requirements We are interested in developers with experience in: - WhatsApp Business Platform / Cloud API. - WhatsApp integrations and connection management. - Phone number verification provider integrations. - Android automation and emulator management. - Node.js, Python, PHP or similar backend technologies. - React, Vue or other modern frontend frameworks. - PostgreSQL, MySQL or MongoDB. - Redis and background task queues. - Docker, Linux VPS administration and CI/CD. - Scalable multi-account management systems. Important Technical Considerations The solution should be designed to support automated workflows while respecting the technical limitations and requirements of the selected communication platform. We are particularly interested in evaluating the compatibility of different virtual number providers, automated onboarding options, connection reliability and infrastructure costs. Please clearly identify any limitations associated with virtual phone numbers, account verification, connection methods and large-scale deployment. We are open to different technical architectures and welcome proposals that can achieve the required functionality in a reliable and cost-effective way. Application Requirements Please provide answers to the following questions: 1. Have you developed a similar multi-account WhatsApp management system? 2. Do you have experience with WhatsApp Business API and alternative integration architectures? 3. Can your solution support 500+ connections through a centralized dashboard? 4. Have you worked with Android emulators and VPS infrastructure? 5. Which virtual phone number providers can you integrate with? 6. What architecture would you recommend for this project? 7. What is your estimated budget and development time for Stage 1? 8. Can you provide examples of similar projects? Project Approach We prefer to start with Stage 1 and establish a working technical foundation before moving to the next stages. The selected developer should provide a clear development plan, technical architecture, estimated costs and demonstrable results for each milestone.

opportunities.title: Bulk Toddler 2D/3D Educational Videos
opportunities.description: I already have a complete set of toddler characters and professionally-mixed songs, each running between one and five minutes. Now I need those assets brought to life in a cohesive YouTube series—either 30 or 50 episodes—so please quote clearly for both quantities. The animation must combine 2D and 3D in a playful, seamless way, keeping every character’s proportions, colours and rig exactly the same from video to video. No AI tools are permitted; I expect traditional key-frame or standard CG workflows in software such as Blender, Maya, Toon Boom or After Effects. Target viewers are 1–2-year-olds, so each clip has to be visually engaging and unmistakably educational. Across the season we’ll cover: • letters, numbers, colours and shapes • songs about daily routines and good habits • animals, vehicles and other simple discovery themes What I provide: high-resolution character files, reference sheets and mastered audio tracks. What you deliver: storyboards, full animation, simple on-screen lyrics/titles, child-friendly pacing, final edit and render (1080p or higher). When you respond, include: • your per-video rate plus totals for 30 and 50 videos • expected turnaround time for each batch • links to samples that prove you can blend 2D and 3D while maintaining a consistent style If your reel matches the brief, we’ll kick off with a paid pilot and proceed to full production without delay.

opportunities.title: Outdoor Steel Pavilion Design
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a complete design package for a freestanding steel pavilion that will shade an 11 m × 7 m seating area in my garden. The goal is an elegant, low-maintenance structure that can handle year-round weather while keeping the space cool and comfortable. What I need from you • Concept options with 3D renders so I can choose a visual style (I’m open to modern, classic, or rustic suggestions as long as the form stays clean and buildable). • Fully detailed CAD drawings—plan, elevation, and sections—with member sizes, connections, and footing details suitable for fabrication. • Basic structural calculations to verify wind and snow loads against typical local building codes. • A concise bill of materials listing steel profiles, plate thicknesses, fixings, and finishes. I already have the exact footprint and site photos; I’ll share those once we start so you can integrate height clearances and existing landscaping. If you routinely work in Revit, AutoCAD, or Tekla that’s a plus, but any mainstream CAD format I can forward to a fabricator is fine. Deliverables will be considered complete when the drawings are fabrication-ready, the calculations check out, and the BOM is clear enough for my steel supplier to price. Let me know your experience with similar outdoor structures and how quickly you can turn the first concept around.

If you routinely work in Revit, AutoCAD, or Tekla that’s a plus, but any mainstream CAD format I can forward to a fabricator is fine. Deliverables will be considered complete when the drawings are fabrication-ready, the calculations check out, and the BOM is clear enough for my steel supplier to price. Let me know your experience with similar outdoor structures and how quickly you can turn the first concept around."

opportunities.title: FixWhistle Service Catalogue Setup
opportunities.description: I have all copy, images and pricing ready for FixWhistle, my new home-services mobile app, and I need them loaded accurately into the admin console. The first catalogue going live is Home Repair and Maintenance Services, so you’ll be structuring every trade—plumbing, electrical, carpentry and more—into clear categories, sub-categories and add-on options. Precision matters most with the service categories and options. You’ll create each service, attach the correct inclusions and exclusions, configure pop-ups, price tiers and add-ons, then upload and arrange the supporting images. When the data entry is complete you’ll open the consumer build of the app, check every screen and confirm that labels, prices and images render exactly as intended. All assets and step-by-step instructions are provided; no coding or copy writing is required. I’m specifically looking for someone who has handled similar catalogue or menu builds inside a mobile or web admin panel. In your application, please highlight that experience—no need for a lengthy proposal. Deliverables • Fully populated Home Repair & Maintenance catalogue in the FixWhistle admin panel • Visual and functional verification in the live app, with any issues flagged and corrected

opportunities.title: Online Assistant for School & Music
opportunities.description: I run a private school while gigging as a part-time musician, and I’m looking for a reliable online assistant who can stay on call from 9 AM – 6 PM, speak clear English, and jump smoothly between my two worlds. Most days you’ll be handling a healthy mix of school administration and music-related support. One moment you might be answering parent emails, updating a student spreadsheet, or tweaking a class schedule in Word; the next you could be confirming a weekend gig, replying to Instagram DMs, or editing a short recap video of our latest recital with titles and still photos. You should feel at home using email, phone calls, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and even the YouTube inbox—those are the channels my students, parents, venues, and followers reach me on. Basic Excel formulas, clean Word formatting, and straightforward video edits (trimming, sequencing, adding lower-third titles and slide-in photos) need to be second nature so I can trust you to polish and post without hand-holding. Typical deliverables include: • Updated student records and lesson schedules by end of day • Prompt, friendly replies routed through the right channel within business hours • Booking confirmations and simple social posts prepared for upcoming shows • Finished event videos exported in social-media-ready formats (1080p, 60-second and 3-minute versions) If you can multitask calmly, keep information organized, and add a touch of creativity to school or music event videos, I’d love to rely on you as my day-to-day remote teammate.

Ensure compliance with Meta WhatsApp Business policies. Requirements: Proven experience with Meta Business Manager and WhatsApp Cloud API. Previous experience resolving WhatsApp account or business portfolio restrictions. Ability to guide us through the official recovery process. Important: We are looking for a genuine Meta policy/API specialist, not someone offering fake unban guarantees. Please share your relevant experience and similar cases handled.

opportunities.title: 10-Second Forest Waterfall Reel
opportunities.description: I’m commissioning an ultra-realistic, 10-second vertical (9:16) cinematic clip that slowly glides toward a tiny, cozy wooden house nestled deep in lush greenery. As the camera makes this gentle forward move, the crystal-clear waterfall should command the viewer’s attention—its sparkle, mist, and motion acting as the scene’s focal point—while warm cabin details, fluttering birds, and softly swaying flowers enrich the background. Key scene notes • Mood & light: bright, fresh morning sunlight filtering through the trees; avoid heavy fog or sunrise orange hues. • Camera path: continuous, slow dolly toward the house—no abrupt pans, cuts, or shakiness. • Atmosphere: dreamy yet believable; subtle depth-of-field, smooth motion blur, and cinematic color grading. • Elements: waterfall foreground prominence, gentle bird flight, animated flowers, light foliage movement. • Duration & format: exactly 10 s, vertical 9:16, minimum 1080 × 1920 (higher resolution welcome). • Clean output: no text, logos, or watermarks. Deliverables 1. Final video in H.264 MP4 and one visually lossless format (e.g., ProRes). 2. Source project files or compositing layers (Blender, Unreal, C4D, etc.) enabling later tweaks. Let me know your preferred tools, how you’ll construct the environment (full 3D, real footage + compositing, or a hybrid), and links to similar photorealistic shots you’ve produced.

As the camera makes this gentle forward move, the crystal-clear waterfall should command the viewer’s attention—its sparkle, mist, and motion acting as the scene’s focal point—while warm cabin details, fluttering birds, and softly swaying flowers enrich the background. Key scene notes • Mood & light: bright, fresh morning sunlight filtering through the trees; avoid heavy fog or sunrise orange hues. • Camera path: continuous, slow dolly toward the house—no abrupt pans, cuts, or shakiness. • Atmosphere: dreamy yet believable; subtle depth-of-field, smooth motion blur, and cinematic color grading. • Elements: waterfall foreground prominence, gentle bird flight, animated flowers, light foliage movement. • Duration & format: exactly 10 s, vertical 9:16, minimum 1080 × 1920 (higher resolution welcome). • Clean output: no text, logos, or watermarks. Deliverables 1. Final video in H.264 MP4 and one visually lossless format (e.g., ProRes). 2. Source project files or compositing layers (Blender, Unreal, C4D, etc.) enabling later tweaks. Let me know your preferred tools, how you’ll construct the environment (full 3D, real footage + compositing, or a hybrid), and links to similar photorealistic shots you’ve produced."

opportunities.title: 1-Minute AI 3D Explainer Animation
opportunities.description: I need a one-minute 3D cartoon created with AI-assisted tools that clearly explains a concept and ends with a strong, persuasive call-to-action. The style should feel engaging and playful while still delivering solid information—think short educational spots you might see before someone decides to click “Sign up” or “Buy now.” You will handle everything from storyboarding and character animation to voice-over syncing, sound design, and final rendering. Whether you rely on Blender, Maya, Unreal Engine, Runway, or a custom AI rigging workflow is up to you; what matters is that the end product looks polished, flows smoothly, and can be delivered in HD (1080p) as an MP4 ready for web or social platforms. Deliverables • Rough storyboard and script draft for my approval • Final 3D animated video (≈60 seconds) with voice-over, music, and SFX mixed • Source project files so I can make future tweaks if needed I’ll provide brand colors, logo assets, and the specific action I want viewers to take. Once you’ve reviewed that material, let me know your proposed timeline and any creative questions you may have.

opportunities.title: Bot WhatsApp Curhat AI
opportunities.description: Saya ingin menghadirkan layanan “tempat curhat tanpa menghakimi” di WhatsApp yang sepenuhnya dijalankan oleh balasan otomatis berbasis AI. Targetnya, siapa pun yang merasa kesepian bisa membuka chat WhatsApp kami dan langsung mendapat jawaban empatik, terjaga kerahasiaannya, serta terasa seolah berbicara dengan teman baik. opportunities.title: Android Belot Auto-Play Bot
opportunities.description: I need an Android automation bot that can open belot.md in Chrome on a real phone, spin up a new table, and then play nonstop until I stop it. The bot should: • Work entirely on an unrooted handset; I will be running it on my own physical device, not an emulator. • Choose the safest, most reliable way to drive the game—whether that ends up being simulated taps with OCR, an accessibility service, or quietly re-playing network calls is up to you, as long as it stays stable and undetectable. • Handle the whole flow: create a fresh table, manage bidding, select trump, register declarations, play every card, detect the final result, close the table, and immediately start over. Game logic I expect it to follow: 1. If I am not the dealer, the bot should bid only when the hand contains – J + 9 of the same suit plus at least one ace in another suit – J plus two more cards in the same suit and one ace elsewhere – Four consecutive cards of one suit – Any five cards of the same suit Otherwise, it must pass. 2. If I am the dealer and none of those exact patterns fit, it should pick the closest match and continue. Throughout play the script needs to track trump, partner position, cards played, running score, and decisions made, so I can review logs afterward. Deliverables • Fully compiled APK or installable service with clear installation steps • Source code and build instructions • Short demo video showing an entire loop (table creation → game play → table close → new table) • Read-me explaining how to update strategies or tweak thresholds if the site UI changes If you have solid experience with Android automation tools (AccessibilityService, UIAutomator, Kotlin/Java, possibly Frida for network replay) and belot logic, I’d love to hear how you’d architect this and a realistic timeline.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40811826, publicado hace 12 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: Anime Motion Comic VFX
opportunities.description: I’m producing a motion-comic style anime film and have the panel artwork ready; what I’m missing is the animation magic that turns static frames into a living scene. I need someone who can take each illustrated panel and add movement, depth-of-field camera work, lighting passes, particles, smooth transitions—everything that gives the project a cinematic feel. Your work will cover all animation and visual-effects tasks, from prepping the layers through to final compositing and export in a high-quality video format. If you’re comfortable in After Effects, Premiere, Blender, or comparable tools and have a reel that shows atmospheric lighting and particle work, I’d love to see it. Once hired, we’ll lock down: • File hand-off format and resolution • A short test scene for style alignment • Milestones for rough cut, revisions, and final master If you can give my panels the polish of an animated film trailer—subtle camera pans, flowing particles, dramatic lighting—let’s talk.

opportunities.title: 5-Axis CNC CAD Machining Expert
opportunities.description: About the project We are looking for an experienced mechanical design engineer with CNC machining knowledge to turn hand-drawn sketches, photos and caliper measurements into a production-ready 3D CAD model and manufacturing drawings for a custom one-piece, heavily skeletonized aluminum stock (aftermarket furniture, tight drop-in fit). The project owner is not an engineer, so the sketches are rough. We need someone who can interpret them, ask smart questions, and deliver a clean, machinable design. What you will do Build a full 3D CAD model from supplied sketches, photos, measurements and reference drawings Merge the original two-piece layout (main body plus front hand guard) into a single-piece stock Design M-LOK cutouts and skeletonized pockets for weight reduction Design internal mounting with pass-through bolt holes to a mini scout mount on the barrel Design the rear interface for an EBR CQB Mod-1 style buttstock, with unthreaded pass-through holes and partial counterbores Optimize the design for 5-axis CNC machining (tool access, fixturing, wall thickness, internal radii) Deliver CAD files and 2D drawings; optionally, 5-axis CNC programming and machining of a prototype

opportunities.title: Portal de Reservas para Casa Vacacional
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar un sitio web propio para mi casa de renta vacacional que permita a cualquier huésped elegir fechas disponibles, pagar el total de la estancia en el momento y recibir la confirmación automática. Todo debe funcionar con pagos en línea seguros —pienso en Stripe o PayPal, aunque estoy abierto a sugerencias— y emitir los correos de confirmación y recibos correspondientes. Necesito que el calendario se sincronice a dos vías con mi anuncio de Airbnb, no solo para mostrar disponibilidad: también debe importar y exportar precios, reservas ya hechas y los mensajes de los huéspedes para evitar doble trabajo. Si hay variaciones de tarifa, temporadas o descuentos, quiero poder actualizarlos yo mismo desde un panel claro y que se reflejen tanto en mi web como en Airbnb. Desde el mismo panel de administración debo: • revisar y gestionar reservas, pagos y calendario en tiempo real • modificar precios, temporadas y cupones sin depender de un desarrollador • crear promociones rápidamente y publicarlas en redes sociales, incluyendo TikTok, Facebook e Instagram, con un par de clics El sitio debe cargarse rápido, ser responsive y quedar bien indexado por Google para captar tráfico orgánico. Agradeceré que la estructura y los textos clave vengan optimizados para SEO básico y que me indiques cómo añadir más contenido después. Entrego branding, fotos y detalles de la propiedad; tú te encargas de diseño, desarrollo, pasarela de pago, conexión con Airbnb y la herramienta de publicación social. Prefiero WordPress + WooCommerce + channel manager compatible, pero escucharé otras stacks si justificas las ventajas. Al finalizar espero: 1.Gestion multiple para enviar publicidad a redes y google 2. Pasarela de pago operativa y reserva 100 % en línea funcionando 3. Sincronización completa con Airbnb verificada 4. Tutorial breve (video o PDF) para que pueda gestionar todo sin asistencia Si tienes experiencia demostrable en sitios de booking vacacional y saber conectar con Airbnb, envíame ejemplos y tu plan de trabajo.

opportunities.title: Importación AliExpress-Shopify Masiva
opportunities.description: Necesito optimizar mi tienda Shopify para añadir rápidamente una gran cantidad de artículos de AliExpress que yo misma iré seleccionando. Busco una solución — sea configuración de una app existente (DSers, AliExpress Dropshipping, Zendrop, etc.) o un desarrollo a medida — que me permita: • Importar solo los productos que elija, pero de forma masiva, y que al traerlos se copie absolutamente toda la información disponible: imágenes, títulos, descripciones, variantes, modelos, precios, stock y opciones de envío. • Una vez que entren pedidos en Shopify, estos deben crearse de forma automática en AliExpress con todos los datos del cliente listos para pagar, sin que yo tenga que intervenir manualmente. Entrego acceso a la tienda y a la cuenta de AliExpress. El trabajo se considera completo cuando pueda: 1. Seleccionar varios enlaces de AliExpress y verlos publicados en Shopify con la información íntegra y bien formateada. 2. Recibir un pedido de prueba en Shopify y confirmarlo levantado automáticamente en AliExpress listo para el pago. Incluye breve guía en video o PDF mostrando cómo repetir el proceso y resolver posibles errores.

opportunities.title: Difusión Shopify en Redes Sociales
opportunities.description: Necesito automatizar y ejecutar la publicación masiva de todo mi catálogo de Shopify — organizado por categorías — en TikTok, Instagram y Facebook. El objetivo es que cada producto se muestre en los tres formatos que más convierten para mi tienda: • Imágenes publicitarias con su precio y la oferta vigente. • Videos cortos que muestren el producto en uso, listos para TikTok/Reels. • Publicaciones con fotos y descripciones completas extraídas del catálogo. Entrego acceso a Shopify y a los perfiles sociales; tú te encargas de seleccionar la mejor herramienta o flujo (puede ser nativo de Shopify, apps de programación o tu propio sistema) para que el proceso quede lo más automatizado posible. Espero artes finales optimizados en tamaño y proporción para cada red, copys persuasivos en español e inglés si fuera necesario y programación del contenido en un calendario inicial de prueba. Acepto propuestas que incluyan: 1. Plan de trabajo con hitos claros para cada red. 2. Ejemplos de piezas visuales antes de publicarlas. 3. Métricas mínimas que medirás para confirmar que el contenido se publica correctamente (impresiones, clicks, etc.). Cuando terminemos la fase de publicación, el objetivo es que el flujo quede documentado para yo poder continuar programando contenido futuro por mi cuenta o repetir la estrategia en nuevas colecciones.

opportunities.title: Traductor Comercial São Paulo
opportunities.description: Necesito incorporar a quien combine traducción con gestión comercial para nuestro próximo impulso de mercado en São Paulo. El trabajo gira en torno al portugués, ya que todas las llamadas y presentaciones a potenciales clientes—empresas del sector industrial—se harán en ese idioma. Lo que harás en el día a día: llamar a prospectos, presentarles brevemente nuestra empresa, recabar sus datos de contacto detallados y mantener un registro limpio y exportable; además, asistirás a ferias y rondas de negocios que se realicen en la ciudad para ampliar la lista de leads. Valoro que vivas en la propia capital paulista para que la logística de las ferias resulte sencilla. Si tu lengua materna es portugués o español y te sientes cómodo vendiendo en portugués con tono profesional, encajarás perfecto. Entrego guiones base, material corporativo y acceso a nuestro CRM; espero de tu parte reportes semanales y la base de datos actualizada como entregable principal. Cualquier duda que tengas sobre la empresa o el enfoque, la resolvemos antes de empezar para que puedas trabajar con total claridad.

opportunities.title: Social Media Manager, UGC Content Creator & Video Editor – Family Travel Brand
opportunities.description: Project Type: Long-term opportunity (starting with a paid trial) Category: Social Media Marketing | Video Editing | UGC Content Creation | Content Strategy Project Overview We are an Australian family of three launching a new travel brand across Instagram and TikTok. We have an extensive collection of travel photos, videos and drone footage from our adventures around the world, which we have recently finished organizing. We are looking for a creative, experienced freelancer who can help us turn our travel content into a successful, income-generating social media business. Our main goal is to monetize our content through UGC brand deals, paid collaborations, sponsored travel and affiliate marketing, while growing an engaged social media audience. We are not simply looking for someone to edit videos. We want someone who understands how to create engaging content, build a recognizable brand and develop opportunities for monetization. Our Content Focus Our brand will feature: - Family travel and adventure: Beautiful destinations, luxury resorts, affordable travel, unique experiences and drone footage. - Neurodivergent family travel: Sharing the challenges, rewards, funny moments and practical strategies involved in travelling the world as a neurodivergent family. - UGC content: Professional, authentic promotional videos designed to attract partnerships with hotels, resorts, tourism operators and travel brands. - Affiliate marketing: Featuring useful travel products, sensory-friendly products and other items relevant to neurodivergent families. Skills We're Looking For Ideally, our freelancer will have experience in: - Professional video and photo editing, including cinematic travel Reels. - Instagram and TikTok content creation and growth strategies. - UGC video creation and content suitable for brand advertising. - Social media marketing, storytelling, hooks, captions and trending content. - Brand partnerships, UGC portfolios and monetization strategies. - Affiliate marketing and integrating products naturally into content. - AI-assisted editing tools and efficient content production workflows. Experience working with travel, family or lifestyle brands would be highly regarded. Initial Trial Project We would like to begin with three professionally edited Reels to assess creativity, editing quality and understanding of our brand. 1. Cinematic Travel Reel: Showcasing beautiful destinations, resorts, adventures and drone footage. 2. Family Introduction Reel: Introducing our family and our neurodivergent travel experiences in a fun, relatable and engaging way. 3. UGC-Style Promotional Reel: Featuring a specific hotel, resort or travel experience, demonstrating the type of professional content we could create for paying brands. We will provide the original footage, photographs, drone videos and branding materials. We welcome creative suggestions regarding music, voiceovers, storytelling and presentation. Any music used for commercial UGC must have appropriate licensing. Long-Term Opportunity If the trial is successful, we hope to establish an ongoing working relationship. Our longer-term goals include: - Publishing approximately 5–7 high-quality Reels per week. - Growing our Instagram and TikTok accounts. - Building a professional UGC portfolio and media kit. - Developing strategies to attract paid UGC contracts and brand collaborations. - Exploring affiliate marketing opportunities. - Eventually expanding into social media management and brand outreach. We are particularly interested in someone who can take initiative, suggest creative ideas and help guide our strategy as the business develops. When Applying Please tell us: 1. What experience do you have with travel content, UGC creation and social media marketing? 2. Have you helped other creators or businesses secure paid UGC opportunities or monetize their content? 3. Can you share examples of Reels you've edited and UGC-style advertisements you've created? 4. Are you comfortable helping with content strategy and audience growth, rather than editing alone? 5. What would you charge for an initial three-Reel trial and an ongoing monthly arrangement? We're looking for a reliable, creative partner who is genuinely interested in helping us build a successful long-term travel content business. We look forward to hearing from you!
